investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agents / production-api)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-09T01:07–01:08Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api layer could not reach the swarm ELB endpoint at /v1/agents. Because the failure occurs before any agent is provisioned, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected, and every contract assertion is unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the AWS ELB-backed service at the redacted us-east-2 endpoint that handles POST /v1/agents — was unreachable from the production-api runtime at the time of the eval run. The production-api returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning", indicating the gateway itself (not the eval runner or the API surface) is the failing dependency. This is an eval-detected infrastructure availability issue localized to the swarm provisioning gateway; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so a confirmed user-facing outage cannot be asserted.
